entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I received last month. It's a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'd like to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. That was 29 days ago. To make sure I'm on the right track, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just a preference. It works as advertised, but it's not what I was looking for in a tracker. I'd just like to send it back.

I understand. I do need to let you know, our return policy for wearable items can be quite strict, primarily for hygiene and sanitation reasons. After this much time has passed, it is often too late to accept a return on a product that's been opened and worn.

I see. I barely used it, and it's in perfect condition. I understand the sanitation concern, but I was hoping we could work something out. Since a full refund might be against the policy, what about a 50% store credit? Or maybe a discount code for a future purchase? I'd really prefer not to be stuck with it.

I appreciate you being flexible, and I can see you're a long-time VeloFit customer. Let me put you on a brief hold and double-check the exact return policy for this specific device. Sometimes different products have different terms. Please hold.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I have some good news. I was looking at the wrong information. It seems I was mistaken about the return window for your specific sensor. For the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, our official policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Oh, really? So it's not too late?
Not at all. You're well within the 90-day window, so I can process this as a standard return for a full refund. My apologies for the confusion.
That's fantastic news! Thank you so much for checking that for me, Charlie.

Of course, happy I could get it sorted out. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on your account. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive it. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's perfect. Thanks again for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
